lines.text: Judah's firstborn Er was wicked, and Judah's daughter-in-law Tamar bore him Perez and Zerah.
Hezron's son Ram was the ancestor of Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz, Obed, and Jesse.
David was Jesse's seventh son, and his sister Zeruiah had three sons: Abishai, Joab, and Amasa.
David reigned seven years and six months in Hebron, then thirty-three years in Jerusalem, where Bathsheba bore Solomon.
Solomon's line ran down to Josiah, whose son Jehoiakim had a son Jeconiah, called the prophet.
